rollups.text: Brookside townhouse purchase and financing: On 2023-02-22, the user viewed a three-bedroom townhouse in Brookside. On 2023-02-25, the user made an offer and agreed with the seller on a $340,000 purchase price. By 2023-03-08, the user was considering a $68,000 down payment and a 30-year mortgage at about 4%, and asked about PMI and estimated monthly costs. The user was also concerned about property taxes and homeowners insurance. Elapsed time from viewing to agreed price: 3 days; from agreed price to financing discussion: 11 days.

University of Melbourne move: The user received an acceptance letter from the University of Melbourne on 2023-02-10. By 2023-03-08, the user was preparing to move to Melbourne before classes, had bought winter clothing with family during 2023-03-04..2023-03-05, and intended to apply for a Student Concession Myki and PTV Tertiary Student ID. The user already had Allianz Care Australia OSHC and wanted to compare student deals. Elapsed time from acceptance to preparation discussion: 26 days.

Reusable water bottle launch and analytics learning: On 2023-03-08, the user was working on launching a new line of reusable water bottles and planned to take two courses in the next quarter to improve data-analysis skills. The user wanted to begin with Google Analytics, track traffic and customer interactions, implement add-to-cart and purchase event tracking (including multi-product carts), and considered taking an ecommerce-tracking course. These were plans and questions; no implementation or course completion was reported.

Podcasts the user listens to or discussed: “How I Built This” hosted by Guy Raz (finished the entire series by 2023-03-08; recommended it to the user's sister, who started listening, date unspecified); “The Daily” from The New York Times (listens during morning jogs; date unspecified; colleague started listening by an unspecified date); “Stuff You Should Know” (enjoyed an episode about the science of dreams; date unspecified). On 2023-03-08 the user said they wanted more inspiring stories after finishing “How I Built This.”
